name: round 3: Score, history and keyboard
tests: score-x, score-o and score-draw read 0 on a fresh page, reset-score is a button, and history-0 alone lists the empty board
a game counts once, when it ends, in two-player mode: X's wins, O's wins and draws, not before the end, not again on New game
the scores survive a reload, and reset-score sets them back to 0
against the computer, a finished game counts once too, whoever starts
history-0 … history-n list every position of the game; a click shows that position's board, status and marks
a move from a past position drops the later moves, and the history follows
a game counts once whatever is replayed: ending it again from its history adds nothing; a new game counts again
against the computer, a jump to the computer's turn lets it play within 1 second, and a jump to the human's turn does not
the arrow keys move the focus between the cells, stopping at the edges, and Enter or Space plays the focused cell
a whole game from the keyboard, with the score and the history following, logs no console error and makes no request outside the page's own server
